gen-gf-sawarabi-mincho-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and a little old-world. Bespoke Sans is the sharper, more open partner, its curves leaving generous gaps beside the stems while Sawarabi Mincho swells gently.
gen-gf-sedan-fs-bespoke-sans: Soft brush-pressed curves, editorial and rounded. Bespoke Sans takes over for the long haul, sharp and refined, with generous gaps where each curve meets its stem, so paragraphs move along without fuss.
gen-gf-sedan-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Sedan SC speaks with quiet authority. Its stroke widths shift just enough to notice, and Bespoke Sans sits beside it as a sharp, open sans-serif that lets those small shifts stand out.
gen-gf-share-tech-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, with sturdy thin lines and wide mouths on its curves. Share Tech is flat and marker-blunt, tightly woven, while Literata is the warmer classic serif.
gen-gf-shippori-mincho-b1-fs-bespoke-san: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, leaving generous space where its curves meet the stems, and it needs no help. Shippori Mincho B1 swells only slightly in its bowls.
gen-gf-sirin-stencil-bitter: Bitter reads dependable and grounded, with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap through each s. Sirin Stencil's drilled-bead counters and uniform strokes make it the loud neighbor.
gen-gf-sirin-stencil-inter: Big, bold, drilled-bead counters. Sirin Stencil commands attention with uniform strokes, while Inter does the quiet work, its tube-like lines and tall lowercase staying open, smooth and easy going.
gen-gf-sirin-stencil-mulish: Round glass-bead counters and flat, unvarying strokes give Sirin Stencil a commanding look. Mulish stays modern and approachable beside it, with horseshoe-open apertures.
gen-gf-sirin-stencil-poppins: Poppins draws rope-loose curves with no thick-thin flicker, and its lowercase stands tall and sturdy. Sirin Stencil adds the bold, bead-counter shout up top, and Poppins keeps the text beneath it modern and clean.
gen-gf-sixtyfour-fs-bespoke-sans: Sixtyfour is typewriter-even and stitched, its terminals tucked close with coarse gaps between. Bespoke Sans opens everything back up, a sharp, refined sans beneath it.
